name: LA-Net (Landmark-Aware Network)
authors_or_creators: Zhiyu Wu, Jinshi Cui (Peking University, China)
publication_venue: ICCV 2023 (IEEE/CVF International Conference on Computer Vision)
param_count: ~12M (ResNet-18 backbone plus auxiliary landmark detection branch) [uncertain on exact total]
accuracy_fer2013: [uncertain] (FER2013 not the primary benchmark in the original paper)
accuracy_affectnet: 64.54% on AffectNet-8 (Overall/WAR); ~67.0% on AffectNet-7 (Overall/WAR) [uncertain on AffectNet-7 number]
inference_fps_or_latency: [uncertain] (not explicitly reported; ResNet-18 backbone enables real-time inference, ~100+ FPS on a single GPU)
hardware_requirements: Training reported on a single NVIDIA GPU (RTX 3090 / V100 class); inference feasible on a single consumer GPU [uncertain on exact specs]
loss_function: Multi-task loss combining Cross-Entropy for expression classification, landmark detection regression loss (auxiliary task), and a landmark-guided attention regularization to combat label noise
training_data_used: RAF-DB, AffectNet, FERPlus (with auxiliary landmark supervision; landmarks obtained from face alignment toolkits)
pretraining_strategy: supervised-pretrain (ImageNet) for ResNet-18 backbone; landmark branch jointly trained
input_modality: RGB image with auxiliary facial landmark supervision (RGB+landmarks during training; RGB-only at inference)
cross_dataset_generalization: [uncertain] (not the primary focus; intra-dataset SOTA emphasized)
robustness: Explicitly designed to combat label noise via landmark-guided attention; reports robustness to synthetic label noise (e.g. 10%/20%/30% flip noise on RAF-DB) and to occlusion/pose variants
explainability: Attention maps (landmark-guided attention) provide interpretability of where the model focuses on the face
deployment_target: server-GPU (lightweight ResNet-18 also feasible for edge/mobile inference)
